title: Speaking — Local transport
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on local transport.

questions: What do you usually do before leaving home?
At what time of day do you feel most alert?
Which part of your routine would you like to change?
Does your routine change during holidays?
Which type of public transport is easiest to use where you live?
What makes you choose to walk instead?

part2.topic: Describe a bus or train journey on which someone was helpful.
part2.closing: and explain how the help changed the journey.

questions: How should transport operators look after passengers during delays?
Why do some residents resist changes to a familiar bus route?
What differences would you expect between a large city and a small town in relation to local transport?
